closed_form.basis: mass identity; invented inputs; straights plus quarter arcs
closed_form.formula: rho A (sum of legs - 2 R (legs - 1) + (pi/2) R (legs - 1))

compared_quantities.bind: mode order, with SWBPIPE's cluster identifier

comparison_conventions: relative deviation = (value - continuum) / |continuum|, the magnitude of the continuum value in the denominator

where a mode's two largest translational components are equal in magnitude, the shape's sign and the participation factor's sign are not compared; frequency, effective mass and combined magnitudes are

conditions: every extracted mode lies strictly inside the table (SWBPIPE refuses outside it; the other program uses the end value)
the mode count cuts at a wide gap, so that a different mass formulation does not change which modes are extracted

other_program_settings.note: the capture also takes every other mode sum and direction sum the program offers, as declared variants of this file; the comparable setting is the one stated here

spectra.ordinate_other_program: acceleration in mm/sec2 (multiply each ordinate by 1000)

family_description: a horizontal L (X, then Z) with one realized 90 degree bend, anchored at both ends, under spectra along X (in the plane) and Y (out of it)
folded_from: folded into the seeded generator from the dynamics lane's wrapper files, dynamics family draft 4, 2026-11-12: the model members by the same arithmetic, byte for byte; the reference values quoted from tools/caepipe_correlation/dynamics_reference_quotes.json

inexact_input_sizes.bend_mass_formulation: SWBPIPE carries a realized bend's mass as two rigid half-arc bodies, each with its half-arc's exact mass, centroid and second moments; each bend here is 0.0204 of the developed length
inexact_input_sizes.mass_formulation: no prediction: this layout has no closed form. On the straight case C the difference between a consistent and a lumped mass at members of this length is tabulated in validation/references/f2_spectrum
inexact_input_sizes.shear_deformation: ESTIMATE, not a reference value: SWBPIPE has no shear deformation in dynamics; the shortest leg here is over 30 outside diameters

mode_count_basis.note: the response is truncated at these modes on both sides alike; no missing mass is requested
mode_count_basis.what: SWBPIPE's own modal solve of this model (in-crate, the production criteria, branch head c8c602df6; an experimental surface, not a released result and NOT a reference value). Given so the mode count can be seen to cut at a wide gap and to hold no repeated cluster
